rawFindings.title: Incorrectly removes 'Reflect' from no-calls list in rule implementation
rawFindings.explanation: The rule no longer reports calls to 'Reflect' as invalid, but the global 'Reflect' object is not callable and should be flagged if called to prevent errors.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore 'Reflect' in the check condition to ensure calls to 'Reflect' are reported as errors, e.g., `if (name === "Math" || name === "JSON" || name === "Reflect")`.

rawFindings.title: Tests no longer validate calls to 'Reflect' are flagged as errors
rawFindings.explanation: The test case that expected an error when calling 'Reflect()' has been removed. This means changes allowing calls to 'Reflect()' will go undetected by automated tests.
rawFindings.suggestion: Reinsert or add a test case to verify that calling 'Reflect()' throws the expected error, consistent with the rule's intended behavior.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect removal of 'Reflect' from no-obj-calls rule without updating documentation and tests properly
rawFindings.explanation: The rule implementation no longer reports 'Reflect' as a non-callable function (line 31), but the associated documentation and tests were only partially updated. The tests still include a test for calling 'Reflect()', which is now obsolete and should not expect an error. The documentation removal should be consistent with the code behavior and tests, ensuring synchronization.
rawFindings.suggestion: Fully remove all references to 'Reflect' in the rule code, documentation, and tests if deprecating it as a forbidden callable. Specifically, remove the 'Reflect()' test case from tests/lib/rules/no-obj-calls.js and ensure documentation reflects this change accurately.
